purpose: Hard production-code freeze verification for the Structural Node Identity & Index Integrity architecture proposal (task §2/§56 final report items 1-4).

productionCodeHash.method: sha256sum of every *.ts/*.tsx/*.prisma file under lib/, app/, prisma/, sorted by path, aggregate sha256 of the resulting listing

keyProductionFileHashes.note: Unchanged throughout this proposal - no production code was modified. These hashes are recorded for a future implementation phase to diff against.

historicalArtifactIntegrity.method: Direct sha256 comparison of every path listed under historicalPhase3FArtifactHashes and phase3F1ArtifactHashes in tests/fixtures/unseen-packages/phase-3f1-1-forensics/phase-3f1-1-freeze-manifest.json against the live file on disk

noNewPackageContamination.method: no new directory created under tests/fixtures/unseen-packages/; no DSGR/FWRG/LSB/CONMED source bytes read or fetched in this proposal beyond preserved, already-historical evidence (phase-3f-first-blind-run/stage1-all-nodes.json census figures, already public in docs/phase-3f1-1-residual-safety-forensics.md)

noPhase4Work.method: no expression runtime, metric evaluator, capacity graph, ledger computation, solver, or financial connector work performed

noProductionBehaviorChange.method: aggregate production hash identical at proposal start and end; no lib/, app/, or prisma/ file appears in `git status --short` as modified
